title: Significance Of Reform Movements
definition: The 19th and 20th-century socio-religious reform movements were organized efforts by the Indian intelligentsia to modernize society by purging irrational, superstitious, and oppressive practices, while simultaneously fostering a sense of national identity.
importanceInUpsc: These movements form the bedrock of modern Indian nationalism, social justice discourse, and the evolution of the Indian Constitution's secular and egalitarian values.
